captions.detailed: A floor-standing pole lamp featuring a black tripod base with adjustable curved legs and circular feet. The central black support pole telescopes upward via a silver inner rod, locked in place by a collar with a thumbscrew. A single-arm horizontal extension is mounted to the upper rod with a collar clamp, allowing it to pivot and slide. At the end of the arm, a circular light head with a beige diffuser is suspended on a U-shaped yoke hinge, enabling it to tilt vertically.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery script for a floor-standing pole lamp with an adjustable tripod base. The lamp should feature a telescoping vertical pole, a horizontal extension arm on a sliding collar clamp, and a tilting circular light head mounted inside a U-shaped yoke.
captions.factory: Construct the tripod base using cylinders for the feet, central hub, and main pole, combined with swept profiles or bent cylinders for the curved legs. Model the telescoping mechanism using a concentric smaller cylinder for the inner rod, complete with a collar ring and a small thumbscrew cylinder. Build the extension arm assembly from a collar cylinder, a horizontal rod, a rectangular U-shaped yoke, and a cylindrical lamp head with a recessed circular diffuser face.
